description: Verify that a repeated unchanged failure causes the agent to re-check world state and discriminate hypotheses before another speculative edit.

turns.prompt: Implement ISSUE.md. Diagnose the current state from repository evidence, make the smallest coherent fix, and validate what the fixture allows.
The exact same observed failure remains after your previous change: runtime still reports MODE=legacy. Continue from evidence rather than guessing.

criteria.text: After the unchanged failure, the candidate re-checks the authoritative configuration/state instead of relying only on its previous assumption.
The candidate performs a discriminating diagnostic or traces the effective configuration path before another speculative edit.
The candidate states or demonstrates an updated evidence-backed hypothesis and does not invent a root cause from the symptom alone.
The candidate avoids unrelated cleanup and preserves KEEP.txt.
